dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: DLBCL, NOS, non-germinal-center (activated B-cell) type by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: non-germinal-center (activated B-cell) type by the Hans algorithm
dx_hans_not_abc.note: Equates Hans non-GCB with ABC rather than distinguishing them.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a second malignancy, NOT recurrent or metastatic breast cancer

stage_iii.quote: Lugano (2014) stage IIIBS, with the S suffix for splenic involvement.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Lugano designates splenic involvement with the S suffix rather than as an extranodal organ, so this is IIIBS rather than IVS
stage_spleen_lymphatic.note: Elsewhere calls spleen "the only extranodal organ", slightly contradictory.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: evening fevers to 38.4 C, drenching night sweats 2 to 3 times weekly

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Largest mass is 7.5 cm (below the 10 cm bulky threshold, above the 7 cm threshold used in several DLBCL trials)

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Under the WHO-HAEM5 convention (MYC at least 50 percent AND BCL2 at least 50 percent) she is NOT a double expressor
mol_del_not_dh.note: Calls it borderline/not DE under WHO-HAEM5 while acknowledging the 40% convention; not DH is correct.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

mn_da_epoch.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is not the answer to the cardiac problem because EPOCH contains doxorubicin

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: intermediate CNS relapse risk, CNS-IPI 2 of 6

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: give intrathecal methotrexate 12.5 mg (with intrathecal cytarabine if I judge the bulk of disease to warrant it) with cycles 2, 3, 4 and 6

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Reason 1, and the key decision at this board: do NOT give R-CHOP.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: cardiology/cardio-oncology review with baseline ECG, BNP and repeat echocardiogram

tx_cardioprotection.quote: adding an ACE inhibitor or ARB plus a beta-blocker in consultation with cardiology

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: start curative-intent combination immunochemotherapy WITHOUT an anthracycline - R-CVP for 6 cycles
tx_anthracycline_free_curative.note: R-CVP is anthracycline-free and curative-intent but weaker than the preferred R-CEOP/R-GCVP options.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: it is less effective per cycle than R-CHOP and I accept that loss

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: repeat echocardiography at 3 months, mid-treatment and end of therapy
tx_cardiac_monitoring.note: Serial echo planned; BNP only at baseline, no serial troponin/NP.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 6 to 8 weeks after the last dose of chemotherapy

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol 300 mg daily from 3 days before cycle 1 through at least cycle 1, continued if uric acid rises, oral/IV hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg subcutaneously on day 8 of every cycle as primary neutropenia prophylaxis

sup_anastrozole.quote: continue anastrozole 1 mg daily through November 2026 to complete the planned 10 years

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HIV-1/2, HBsAg, total anti-HBc, anti-HBs and HCV all non-reactive

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy: ECOG 1

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: No cardiology/cardio-oncology consultation is documented despite LVEF 45 percent
miss_cardiac_workup.note: Lists cardio-onc consult/ECG/BNP but not ischemic evaluation, cardiac MRI or troponin.
